leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply semantic HTML elements to structure content with proper accessibility roles
Use ARIA attributes to enhance accessibility for custom interactive components
Implement keyboard navigation by handling keyboard events for custom controls
Execute focus management to ensure logical tab order and visible focus indicators
Utilize proper labeling techniques to associate form inputs with descriptive text
Construct accessible forms with appropriate input types, validation, and error messages
Define accessible color contrast ratios to ensure text readability for all users
Invoke screen reader announcements for dynamic content updates using ARIA live regions
Handle focus trapping for modal dialogs to maintain accessibility when opened
Return accessible component structures with proper heading hierarchies and landmarks
Assign appropriate alt text to images based on their context and function
Control interactive element states using ARIA attributes for buttons, toggles, and menus
